provenance: Compiled from a disclosed real state-feedback development rollout. Runtime actions use only fixed joint commands, action index and robot proprioception/time. Fresh whole cold-reset validation is required.

checkpoints.label: Approach moving arm handle
Grasp arm support handle
Support the arm level
Orient right hand outside the mechanism
Approach counterweight handle
Grasp counterweight slider
Slide counterweight to the pin index
Release aligned counterweight
Lift above the counterweight after release
Clear the slider lane above the fixture
Approach locking pin
Grasp locking pin head
Lift locking pin from its stand
Route pin around the counterweight handle
Align pin above both holes
Guide pin into both bearing sections
Release guided pin to seat under gravity
Lift fingers vertically clear of the pin receiver
Allow the guided pin to settle under gravity
Clear the pin and slider
Remove support from the balanced arm
Withdraw from service arm
